# brig stop

Shut a VM down

## Synopsis

```text
brig stop [NAME]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --force` | power off immediately instead of shutting down gracefully |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
